author: Totally Not Mark
description: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has marked the beginning of new era for Dragon Ball. One that may or may not progress like we think it might. Will the Goku Black arc be remastered? What about the Universe Survival Arc and the Tournament of Power? There are so many different variables up in the air and today I want to examine what this new era of Dragon Ball might mean for its future.
title: Remastering Goku Black will be… HARD.
